summary: BayCom Corp filed an 8-K to announce a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.30 per share, payable July 9, 2026 to holders of record June 11, 2026. The dividend is a routine capital return event typical for a commercial bank holding company. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or forced management change is disclosed. The filing solely reports the declaration of a recurring dividend under Item 8.01. This is a standard capital-return announcement, not a special situation.
